```ruby title="Ruby"
require "liter_llm"
begin
  result = LiterLlm.create_response(LiterLlm::CreateResponseRequest.new(input: 'Hello', model: 'nonexistent-model'))
rescue StandardError => error
  warn "#{error.class}: #{error.message}"
end
```
